headline: Indo Borax acquires 64.26% stake in Kronox Lab Sciences
hook: Indo Borax gains majority control of Kronox
summary: Indo Borax & Chemicals has finalized the acquisition of a 64.26% stake in Kronox Lab Sciences. This move grants Indo Borax a controlling interest in the specialty chemicals manufacturer. The transaction marks a significant expansion for Indo Borax within the chemical sector. Retail investors should note the potential for consolidated earnings and operational synergies between the two entities.
why_it_matters: Consolidation may improve operational efficiency and earnings for Indo Borax.
winners_losers: Indo Borax gains / Kronox shareholders see ownership shift

headline: Indo Borax & Chemicals issues press release under SEBI regulations
hook: Routine corporate filing from Indo Borax
summary: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited has submitted a press release to the stock exchanges pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations. The filing was dated October 1, 2026. Specific details regarding the contents of the press release were not disclosed in the exchange notice. Retail investors should check the company's official filing for the specific details of the announcement.
why_it_matters: No immediate financial impact without details

headline: Small-cap dividend gems: Nine stocks offer yields of up to 16%
hook: High payouts among lesser known names
summary: Majestic Auto announced a dividend of ₹60 per share for FY 2025-26, translating to a 16.8% yield as shares rose 1.37% to ₹370 with a market cap of ₹384.71 crore. Indo Borax shares fell 3.23% while offering a ₹40 per share dividend yielding 7.9%. Other featured stocks in the list include Premco, PTC India, and Honda Power. These micro and small-cap yields offer alternative income streams for retail investors tracking high-dividend options.
why_it_matters: High dividend yields provide cash returns from small-cap holdings.
winners_losers: Dividend-focused retail investors gain / micro-cap volatility risks apply
